sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background illustration for the Korean fantasy game 숲켓몬 Chuseok event. Create a gorgeous cinematic 2D painted Korean hanok veranda at night during Chuseok, wide landscape 1536x1024. A large full harvest moon and graceful roof silhouette, distant autumn trees and very subtle golden dust in deep midnight navy sky. Warm lantern-lit wooden serving table fills the lower half with a large, EMPTY usable dark lacquer tabletop, seen slightly from above, for separate interactive songpyeon rice cakes and gift-envelope assets to be rendered on top. Navy ink, jade highlights and warm antique gold light, painterly fine material detail, elegant high-end Korean game art. Keep center of scene uncluttered, calm negative space above table for live UI dialogue. No characters, no food, no envelopes, no writing, no logos, no watermark, no UI panels. Atmospheric but objects placed over the table must remain easily readable; deep navy shadows, no bright white center.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: six-cell 2D game sprite sheet, exact 3 columns by 2 rows, 1536x1024, equal 512x512 cells with no grid lines, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background. Each cell is a centered closeup, matching scale and camera angle, plenty of transparent padding. A beautifully painted glossy Korean half-moon SONGPYEON rice cake on a tiny dark jade saucer with a single pine sprig. Top row cells left to right: one ivory songpyeon, one blush pink songpyeon, one pale mugwort jade-green songpyeon; fully closed smooth crescent forms, appetizing softly translucent rice dough, elegant realistic 2D game art, warm gold rim light. Bottom row left to right: the matching ivory, pink, green rice cakes split into two clearly separated halves exposing golden sesame-honey filling, the saucer and camera exactly consistent with top row. No faces, no text, no symbols, no hands, no scene background, no shadows outside the cells, no visible cell borders. NO checkerboard painted into the image. This is a production transparent sprite atlas, not a UI mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: six-cell 2D Korean Chuseok gift envelope game sprite atlas, exact 3 columns by 2 rows, 1536x1024, six equal 512x512 cells, no drawn cell borders, genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Matching centered scale and camera angle in every cell, isolated production sprites. Three traditional Korean horizontal money envelopes viewed front-on at a slight downward camera angle, hanji paper with premium embossed delicate gold harvest-moon and cloud motifs, tasteful ornamental seals without characters. Top row left to right: deep jade envelope closed with small gold round seal; dusty coral-red envelope closed with same round seal; midnight navy envelope closed with same gold seal. Bottom row: exactly the matching jade, coral, navy envelopes OPEN, top flap unfolded upward, a blank ivory prize certificate rising slightly from the opening with restrained gold edge glow. No money denominations, no currency symbols, no writing, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no people or hands, no scene background. Painterly high-end 2D game item illustration with refined paper textures, clear silhouette. All envelope edges entirely within their own cell and equal padding. No checkerboard texture.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: sequential 8-frame animation sprite atlas for Korean game SONGPYEON rice-cake making, exact 4 columns by 2 rows, landscape 2048x1024, each frame an equal square, transparent background, no borders. Eight consecutive genuine action frames, left-to-right then next row, identical fixed camera directly above a pair of beautiful adult hands and a piece of ivory rice dough at center. Wrists enter from lower left and lower right, cropped only at each cell boundary; natural five fingers and consistent adult hands, elegant painterly 2D game illustration, warm light, navy silk sleeve cuffs. Frame1: round smooth ivory rice dough ball resting between open hands. Frame2: both thumbs press the ball into a thick disk. Frame3: hands form disk into cupped dough. Frame4: small mound of golden sesame filling in the cup, fingers around rim. Frame5: folding the dough in half over the filling. Frame6: fingertips pinch the crescent seam. Frame7: hands smooth the plump crescent songpyeon. Frame8: open hands present a finished glossy half-moon rice cake. The action and dough shape change materially each frame, not just translation. Equal scale and center registration across all frames, all hands and rice dough isolated on real transparent alpha. No utensils, no table, no backdrop, no grid, no writing, no text, no logos, no symbols, no checkerboard.
